references.text: Here is also mentioned the counting of Merari's sons, which was 6200. Chapter 4 counts only the men fit for service between the ages of 30 and 50, which explains the lower number of 3200.
These verses introduce the counting of Merari's sons by their clans, which verse 44 summarizes with the total number.
This verse confirms that the 3200 were those mustered from Merari's clans, in accordance with the Lord's command through Moses.
A similar count of Kohath's sons, who numbered 2750 men fit for service. This shows the pattern by which the Levites were counted by their clans.
A similar count of Gershon's sons, who numbered 2630 men fit for service. Together with Kohath and Merari, this made up the total Levitical workforce.
Summary of all the Levites' men fit for service, totaling 8580, which includes the 3200 from Merari's clan mentioned in verse 44.
